production_layout.digits: Detect real empty row boundaries instead of assuming an exact generated grid. Normalize full glyph cap heights, baselines and transparent margins.
production_layout.guide: Reposition generated Chinese glyphs without deforming them; moderate tracking around 5.5% of cap height, wider word break in the tower-combination row.
production_layout.skins: Nine-slice generated artwork, continuous underlay and overlapping clips to prevent fractional-density seams.
